CLM-PROC-0030.statement: Experimental vertically oriented wide-trench lines milled through a gold film achieved a linewidth of 50.0±2.7 nm.

extra_quotes: Samples were fabricated and imaged using an FEI Helios Nanolab 600 DualBeam FIB/SEM system: The patterns were milled through a 50 nm thermally evaporated gold film supported on a 50 nm silicon nitride membrane, using a fixed ion beam current of 10 pA and a dose of 7 mC/cm².

The conditional diffusion model was trained using a composite loss function: The primary loss was the standard denoising mean squared error, which trains the network to predict the Gaussian noise added to each SEM image.

Linewidths are evaluated for each 256-pixel length of each line (in each of the 18 experimental SEM image patches, and each of the 200 pseudo -SEM images), after binarization with a fixed intensity threshold (of 0.7), as averages over 64 equally spaced points (i.e. at 4 -pixel intervals)
